title: Panda in a Costume
text: The next day… We took advantage of a lull to head over to Siltvelt. Father took Keel and Sakura-chan to the tavern where the Panda was. The eggs haven’t hatched yet, but they’ll hatch any day now.
“Oh? Long time no see. How’s it going?”
The panda beastman who was enjoying a card game at the tavern beckoned to Father.
“So-so, I guess. How about Lars-chan?”
“I see, I see. I’m staying here because I caught a whiff of war, but with no news, I’m getting a bit bored. If I weren’t going on whimsical hunting trips with you, I’d have gone to Zeltoble by now.”
“War…”

My father-in-law fell silent upon hearing the word “war.” That’s right. Considering how poorly my Father has been treated, it wouldn’t be surprising if Siltvelt decided to go to war at any moment. But there’s no need to worry. The Queen of Melromarc is doing everything she can through diplomacy to prevent a war.

“It’s just a rumor I heard, though. Apparently, there’s blatant discrimination against the Shield Hero in Melromarc. The people are starting to get into a war-like mood. You guys should be careful, too.”
“Yeah. I’ll be as careful as I can. Well… I think we’ll be fine since Keel’s here, though.”
“I wonder how things’ll go with that little mutt around.”
“What did you say! Are you saying I’m unreliable?”
Keel barks menacingly at the Panda Beastman.
“Now, now. That’s why you came to bother Lars-chan, isn’t it?”
“Coming to rely on me… You get all cocky the moment I’m nice to you once. I’m not exactly idle myself, you know.”
“Aren’t the people playing cards over there idle…?”
“Ugh… Shut up. It doesn’t matter anyway.”
“Well, anyway, I thought, ‘If you’ve got some free time, how about we go hunting together?’ That’s why I came to ask.”
“Even so…”
“Of course, I’ll pay you well. Motoyasu-kun.”
“Yes, sir.”

I pulled out the outfit my Father had ordered—one designed to suit a panda beastman. I made something very similar to the outfit I’d designed for Keel. A panda beastman who was about to take a drink of sake let out a “Pfft!” and coughed when he saw the outfit.
“Guh! Guh! W-what is that outfit?!”
“Of course. It’s for Lars-chan. Oh, it’s a matching set with Keel’s.”
“Is that cool-looking girl going to wear this? I don’t think it’ll suit her.”
“It’ll be fine. Just like with Keel, it’ll look good on her.”
“I’m not dressing like this because I want to! My big brother made me wear it.”
Even in his dog form, Keel is made to wear his peddler’s outfit. It’s about time I considered switching to an outfit made with Magical Power.
“I said it wouldn’t look good on me! Were you even listening!?”
“That’s why I told you before. It looks good on you, so I had it made. Besides, I think you look cute just the way you are right now, too.”
With that, my Father took the clothes from me and handed them to the Panda Beastman.
“W-well, I… um… that’s exactly why I said it’s not my style!”
It’s just a hunch, but is it my imagination, or did she seem to blush a little?

“In that form, maybe you should try adding a ribbon or something? Like a Cat Companion—a hat or some clothes might actually suit you. Just like how Keel-kun looks good in a maid outfit even in his puppy form.”
“That’s exactly what I mean! Ugh, seriously… Just listen to me! If you don’t cut it out, I’m going to get mad!”
“Oh, calm down. Alright, let’s start with something not too fancy—maybe tie a bandana around your head…”
My father tied a bandana around the panda beastman’s head. The panda beastman doesn’t seem to be putting up any resistance. If anything, he’s sighing with a hint of resignation.
“Next, a ribbon here. And a big ribbon around the waist as an accent—”
He tied a slightly oversized ribbon around the panda beastman’s back.
“Why are you doing this to me… Ugh, seriously…”
Even as he muttered things like that, the panda beastman didn’t resist Father dressing him up. After that, she looked at her reflection with a sort of exasperated air.
“What’s so fun about making me look like this?”
“I was wondering if the ‘gap moe’ would work… There’s a lot of fun in dressing people up. Lars-chan, you’re cute when you’re in your Demi-Human form, so show me next time.”
“I-I’m not cute at all!”
However, when her Father held up a mirror to her, the Panda Beastman froze.
“Is this… me?”
“Yeah. I think you’re just as cute as Keel. It looks like you’ve been taking good care of your fur, just like I told you last time—it’s getting all fluffy.”
“This… it’s like a lie.”
At that moment, one of the panda beastman’s subordinates grabbed her father by the collar.
“Hey! You! What do you think you’re doing?! If you interfere any further, we’ll beat the crap out of you!”
“What the hell are you guys doing?!”
The panda beastman snapped back to his senses and yelled at his subordinate.
“How dare you turn our boss into a lecherous sow! Ever since she met you, she’s been worrying about her gait and her fur—there’s no trace left of the boss we used to know!”
“A lecherous sow… I’m not Motoyasu-kun, you know…”
Huh? Did I do something wrong? That’s right. There’s something I need to tell this Panda Beastman.
“I can’t have you getting the wrong idea.”
“About what?”
“She’s a Panda, not a pig!”
My Father looked a bit worn out.
“Motoyasu, just keep quiet, okay?”
“Got it.”
Then my Father turned his gaze back to the Panda Beastmen.
“A-anyway, the way the boss lady strikes a pose in front of the mirror… put yourselves in our shoes and see how that makes us feel!”
“Y-yeah, you’re right! That outfit really is a no-go! Even I must’ve lost my mind to wear such a ridiculous outfit—”
Just as the Panda Beastman said that—
“All that’s left is to put on that costume, and it’ll be perfect!”
When Father gave a thumbs-up, his subordinates gave thumbs-ups as well. They get along well, don’t they?
“Ah… to think that tomboyish big sis could become so charming… that’s amazing. Please, let me call you ‘Big Brother.’”
“Huh!?”
The panda beastman’s voice cracked.
“Not yet… Lars-chan’s charm doesn’t stop at this level. Not only when she’s a Demi-Human, but even in her Beastman form, she’s bound to become even more alluring!”
“W-what?! Big Bro! No, Reverend! Please raise Big Sis into a lewd sow who captivates everyone, and turn her into the ultimate woman who’ll treat us like good boys! Please!”
“You guys, I’m going to torture you later! Mark my words!”
With a thud, the panda beastman punched all his subordinates—including Father—with his knuckles. Ah, it seems that it had absolutely no effect on my Father.
“Sigh… How did it come to this?”
“She’s got good potential, so let’s polish her up some more.”
“Yeah, yeah. Alright, let’s go. Where are we headed today?”
Looking thoroughly fed up, the Panda Beastman scratched his head noisily and formed a party with my Father.
“Shall we go defeat some standard monsters that’ll bring in some cash?”
“Hmm… Motoyasu, do you have any ideas?”
“I’d recommend a dragon deep in the mountains.”
“A dragon…? Just how dangerous a place are you planning to take me to! No, are you trying to kill us all?!”
Are there really dragons that strong? Given my Father’s current strength, I think he could easily handle a dragon that even a Level 100 adventurer couldn’t defeat and protect his party.
“Before that, shouldn’t we check on how the plants we planted are doing? I’ve entrusted the management to the kingdom’s people, but told them not to get too close.”
“Oh, right. If it goes well, that’ll solve our food shortage, right?”
“Exactly. Just to be safe, I asked them to plant them far away from any settlements.”
“Well then, let’s check on them before we go. Will Lars-chan come with us?”
“Wait, you said the kingdom is doing something for us… Who the hell are you guys, anyway?”

So, we headed to the land where we’d planted the bio-plant seeds. In Siltvelt, I chose a wilderness where no one ever ventured and planted the bio-plant seeds there. But now, the spot where I’d planted them had turned into a dense forest of plants. It’s a fantastical forest where all kinds of fruits grow, spreading both abundance and terror. Somehow, it looks like flower-like, humanoid creatures are striding about inside the forest.
“Isn’t this the place everyone’s been talking about lately?! What have you guys done?!”
The Panda Beastman is making a fuss.
“I heard the government isn’t taking it seriously, and that their influence is gradually expanding. Could it be that you guys are the culprits!?”
